profile.headline: Software Engineer (Consultant @ M&T Bank)
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the bank , health, accounting, and parcel shipping industries. Skilled in SQL Server Database, Java, .NET Framework, Integration, Web API, XML, Google Storage & BigQuery, ETL, and Solution Architecture. Strong business development professional with a Master's degree focused in Computer Science from North Dakota State University.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provides designs, specifies information systems solutions and highly technical direction in the development of new or existing applications to solve basic to complex problems or enhancements.

Serves as a principal application designer for major modifications effectively using analytical and technical skills and available technology and tools in the evaluation of client requirements and processes.

Completes and oversees basic to complex systems analysis, design, and development. Plays a key role as an individual contributor on complex projects. Maintains an excellent functional understanding of the supported application(s).

Participates with other Development, operations, and Technology staff in overall systems development direction from technical analysis to user acceptance testing.

Evaluates and understands complex interrelationships and effects among programs, interfacing applications and platforms. Provides highly analytical consulting and leadership in identifying and implementing new uses of information technologies to assist business units in meeting strategic objectives.

Prepares thorough, clear technical and functional specifications and update systems documentation. 

Prepares charts, tables, and diagrams to assist in analyzing problems. Reviews documentation prepared by less experienced staff. Prepares and reviews assessments to include required tasks, estimates time frames and effort for any scope project.

Follows and promotes use of development standards and procedures.

Maintains a good understanding of the business being supported and its functions, processes, operations, and strategic direction.

Key technologies: Java Springboot (Web API) // Web API Design and Development Concepts – REST API, SOAP, XML, JSON // SQL, Git, CI/CD, VS Studio Code, Postman/SoapUI
